import.title: Import products from Excel
import.intro: Upload the Excel file with your products (your own or our template). Before saving you'll see what will be created, and common problems can be fixed in one click.
import.helpTitle: How to fill in the template
helpLines: Only Name is required. If SKU, category or price are missing, we'll offer to fix them in bulk when importing.
You don't have to use this template: you can upload the Excel file you already have. If we don't recognize a column, we'll ask you which one it is.
Categories and suppliers that don't exist are created automatically.
If a SKU already exists in your company, you choose whether to skip it or update its data (stock is never changed from here).
Cost: what the product costs you (optional). Initial and minimum stock: whole numbers for per-unit products; kg, liters or meters allow up to 3 decimals.
Unit (unit, kg, g, L, mL, m, cm, m²), VAT (13, 4, 2, 1 or Exempt) and CABYS (13 digits) are optional: without them the product is per unit, 13% VAT and no CABYS. The sale price includes VAT.
Expiration: date in YYYY-MM-DD format or a date-formatted cell.
Up to 2000 rows per file. Only the first sheet is read.
import.onlyXlsx: The file must be an Excel file (.xlsx). If you have an .xls or .csv, open it in Excel and save it as .xlsx.
import.empty: The file has no product rows.
import.tooMany: The file has more than 2000 rows. Split it into several files.
import.unreadable: The file could not be read. Make sure it is a valid .xlsx.
import.failed: The import could not be completed

import.doneProblems_other: {{count}} rows were not imported or were skipped.
import.mapHint: We couldn't find the name column. Choose which column of your Excel file matches each field. Anything missing (SKU, category, price) is handled in the next step.

import.pendingNote_other: {{count}} products will be imported without a price and marked “To complete”. You'll find them in Products to set their prices.
